products_without_attachments.map:
function (doc) {
  if(doc.type == "product") {
    var dw = {};
    dw._id= doc._id,
    dw.colours = doc.colours,
    dw.type = "product",
    dw.font_size = doc.font_size,
    dw.baseline = doc.baseline,
    dw.font = doc.font,
    dw.price = doc.price,
  dw.buy_it_now_number = doc.buy_it_now_number,
  dw.description = doc.description,
  dw.svgupload = doc.svgupload,
 dw.monochromatic = doc.monochromatic,
       dw.tags = doc.tags
  
    emit(doc._id, dw)
  }
}
